result.summary: The image shows a wide intersection with a paved sidewalk and curb ramp but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The open road geometry and lack of markings create an environment where pedestrians are exposed to traffic without clear priority or protection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path across the wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway at the intersection corner.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While a traffic light is present for vehicles, there are no visible pedestrian signal heads to indicate safe crossing times.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corner near the traffic light pole.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides of the street, supported by overhead traffic signals. However, the wide turning radii and parked vehicles near the crossing points create potential visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side of the image may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the main roadway near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Wide Intersection Throat
hazards.description: The side street on the left has a wide, undefined entry point which increases pedestrian exposure time and allows for higher-speed vehicle turns.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Constructing curb extensions would shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight before they step into the roadway.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Installing dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk on one leg, controlled by standard traffic signals. However, the wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or physical refuge areas increase exposure for people crossing.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance without a refuge island or curb extensions.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility zebra markings to all legs of the intersection to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra-style crosswalk markings and continuous sidewalks on both sides of the street. While the environment includes traffic signals and a bike lane, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the absence of a median refuge island increase the exposure risk for people crossing the roadway.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are clearly visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to uncertainty for pedestrians regarding when to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corners where signals would typically be mounted.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a median refuge, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: The marked crosswalk spanning the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear guidance on crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.
